description:
## Why

`Finding` currently records lint_id, citation, evaluated_at_unix, rule_bundle_version — but not which cert triggered the finding. For evidence packs intended to be auditable (OSCAL Assessment Results, federal compliance exports), each finding should pin to a specific cert by content hash so the evidence is replayable.

## What

Add `cert_sha256: [u8; 32]` to `Finding`. SHA-256 of the DER-encoded cert that triggered the lint. The lint engine computes this once per cert per evaluation run and stamps it on each emitted finding.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `Finding.cert_sha256` field present, populated by `LintRunner::run_cert`.
- [ ] Serde round-trips correctly (hex or base64 in JSON, raw bytes in postcard etc.).
- [ ] Evidence-pack documentation updated to call out cert_sha256 as the provenance field.
- [ ] Crate version bumped (additive to a non_exhaustive struct).

## Why not done already

Earlier design deferred this to avoid adding a SHA-256 dep to the engine core. Revisit: pkix-lint already depends transitively on `sha2` via x509-cert, so the dep cost is zero.

## Filed as

Tracker for pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:481 'Planned fields' rustdoc block. Surfaced by PKIX-agp7.2 sweep audit.
title: pkix-lint: add Finding.cert_sha256 field for evidence-pack provenance
